metadata.name: Personalized Recommendation & Remediation Evaluation
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Controlled synthetic evaluation benchmark. Does NOT claim real student learning gains, exam score improvements, or validated pedagogical efficacy. Strictly evaluates software engineering invariants and algorithmic properties: multi-signal prioritization, uncertainty distinction, prerequisite remediation, downstream blocker awareness, recent-action damping, mastered concept deprioritization, conflicting evidence handling, source grounding and missing-source safety, assessment delegation, student isolation, and determinism.

scenarios.name: High-Confidence Weakness Triggers Strong Remediation
scenarios.description: Student has assessed score S=0.25 at C=0.90 across multiple quizzes. Recommender must prioritize the concept, assign LOW_KNOWLEDGE reason code, and select active remediation (PRACTICE_CONCEPT or REVIEW_CONCEPT).

scenarios.name: Low-Confidence Uncertainty Distinguished from Weakness
scenarios.description: Concept has score S=0.25 with nascent confidence C=0.15 and zero assessments. Recommender must assign LOW_CONFIDENCE, must NOT assign LOW_KNOWLEDGE (false deficit), and recommend initial study.

scenarios.name: Prerequisite Remediation Unblocks Downstream Learning
scenarios.description: Concept A (LTI System) is a direct prerequisite of Concept B (Convolution). When Concept A is unmastered, Concept B recommends REVIEW_PREREQUISITE, and Concept A receives DOWNSTREAM_BLOCKER boost.

scenarios.name: Downstream Blocker Weight Reflects Curriculum Impact
scenarios.description: Concept A blocks multiple unresolved downstream concepts, while Concept B blocks none. Concept A must receive higher downstream_blocker_score than Concept B.

scenarios.name: Recent-Action Damping Prevents Repetitive Domination
scenarios.description: Two equally weak concepts: Concept A was acted upon 2 minutes ago, while Concept B was not. Concept B must achieve higher priority due to recent-action penalty on A.

scenarios.name: Mastered Concepts Deprioritized Below Unresolved Topics
scenarios.description: Concept A is MASTERED (S=0.85, C=0.80) while Concept B is DEVELOPING (S=0.60, C=0.60). Unresolved Concept B must rank above Mastered Concept A.

scenarios.name: Conflicting Evidence (UNCERTAIN) Triggers Diagnostic Action
scenarios.description: Concept has mixed correct and incorrect assessments resulting in UNCERTAIN status. Recommender must flag UNCERTAIN reason code and recommend diagnostic assessment or focused review.

scenarios.name: Review Recommendations Grounded in Curriculum Chunks
scenarios.description: Concept Convolution has verified textbook chunks [CHUNK_SS_001, CHUNK_SS_004]. Recommender must set source_available=True and preserve chunk provenance.

scenarios.name: Missing Source Concepts Flag Explicit SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
scenarios.description: Hypothetical concept lacking curriculum chunks must explicitly declare source_available=False and assign SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE without fabricating citations.

scenarios.name: Assessment Action Delegates to Adaptive Assessment Service
scenarios.description: Recommendation with TAKE_ASSESSMENT delegates question selection to AdaptiveAssessmentService, obtaining valid item with intact source provenance without duplicating selection logic.

scenarios.name: Student Recommendation Isolation
scenarios.description: Student A (weak in Convolution) and Student B (mastered Convolution) receive completely isolated recommendation rankings with zero state leakage across student IDs.

scenarios.name: Deterministic Ranking Invariant
scenarios.description: Executing recommendation generation twice for the same student state and history yields identical rankings, priority scores, and explanations.
